Red apple | bright red, held in right hand both hands nearby | at 00:08 the held object renders white/pale; at 00:09 absent | color change and disappearance with no put-down or eating action
Produce stalls | tomatoes, limes, oranges, apples in crates | same layout | teal/blue round fruit appears in crates at 00:04-00:06 and 00:08

findings.description: From 00:06 to 00:08 both of the woman's hands are occupied with the apple (right hand open beside it) and no hand contacts the shaft; at 00:07 the shaft ends in mid-air at chin height with a black tip while the canopy stays perfectly stable overhead, i.e. the umbrella is effectively floating.
The shaft passes in front of the woman's face at 00:04-00:05, is behind her head/shoulder at 00:06 with no arm or body movement to explain the jump, and is in front again at 00:07.

The held object is consistently a red apple from 00:00-00:07, but at 00:08 it renders as a white/pale object in her clasped hands, and by 00:09 the apple is gone entirely with no action of putting it down, eating it, or handing it off.
Crates of teal/blue round fruit appear at the left stall at 00:04-00:06 and again on the right at 00:08; no naturally teal or blue apples/tomatoes exist, indicating hallucinated produce coloration.
The white sign at top left shows a '6' surrounded by nonsensical garbled glyphs that form no real word, a typical generated-text artifact, visible through 00:02.
A thin white horizontal spike protrudes from the bridge of the woman's nose at 00:07, an anatomically impossible artifact lasting about one frame.
The passing man's glasses are warped and melt into his face; the frame and temple do not connect to his ear, appearing as a smeared rendering artifact.
